C09 is a much weaker parallel appreciation letter whose similarities are largely conventional.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Your name stands out among those of the many devoted public servants who have labored tirelessly to win the victory for freedom in Greece.","parent_excerpt":"Due to the heroic efforts of the Greek people and the American Mission for Aid to Greece, but due also in large measure to the leadership which you provided, Greece has been saved as a democratic nation","explanation":"Both single out Griswold’s leadership as materially responsible for preserving Greece."},{"child_excerpt":"Initiation of the Greek aid program involved the planning, organization and setting in motion under emergency conditions of a large-scale undertaking... it was under your firm guidance that the program was carried successfully through the first fourteen months of its application.","parent_excerpt":"On June 10, 1947 you undertook the assignment of Chief of the American Mission for Aid to Greece... It was to direct that effort that you responded to your nation's call and took up your task in Greece.","explanation":"The child expands the same chronological account of Griswold taking charge of the aid mission under emergency conditions."},{"child_excerpt":"You may take justifiable pride in the part you have played in this positive and significant achievement of American foreign policy.","parent_excerpt":"In accepting your resignation as Chief of the American Mission for Aid to Greece, I wish to extend to you my personal thanks and those of the people of the United States for a job well done.","explanation":"Both close by converting the account of successful leadership into formal presidential appreciation."},{"child_excerpt":"your intimate knowledge of that country, derived from long years of devoted service there, enabled you to detect and point out with great clarity the symptoms of a deteriorating situation","parent_excerpt":"Your broad and farsighted understanding of international developments with respect to Greece helped crystallize American determination to uphold the vital principles at stake in the present Greek situation.","explanation":"This secondary correspondence with C12 shows that the child’s MacVeagh segment likewise reuses an earlier individualized commendation, reinforcing that the child is a composite of prior appreciation-letter templates."}]}
